rubrics.text: and turning from side to side amel.
extending to back of head and neck
if nail would be torn out
as if nail would enter flesh
leaves upper and goes to lower limbs
alternately in one or the other
on raising the arm in bed
alternately in one or the other
feels a rat running up the leg
must put it out of bed to cool it
as if severed from his body
under nail of left great toe
agg. putting foot down after rising from bed
arm and left leg at night
when lying on the left side
cannot bear to have fingers touch each other
and letting limbs hang out of bed amel.
sensation of cold water dripping from
cold feet had been put in hot water
cold water were poured on them
sensation as if dipped into cold water
cold water running down to toes
hip seems bathed in warm water
drops of cold water trickled down front of
water sensation as if cold water were running from clavicle down to toes along a narrow line
shifting from one to the other
passing over and extending to fingers
